analysis.title: GS Lee - Flows & Positioning, Feedbacks, Fundamental Ideas 19 Oct 2026
key_insights: Last Friday showed the first real panic in index protection. VIX futures traded 3.6x the 20-day average, Cboe index put volume was a record daily high, and total put volume was the fourth-highest since 2015.
VIX call option volume was the second-highest in five years, behind only August 2, 2024, which preceded the VIX spike above 60 the following Monday.

The GS high quality vs low quality pair (GSP1QUAL) is up 20% over 3 months to a 12-month high on about 13% realized vol. The short leg (GSX1BFQS) sold off as higher rates hurt long-duration, highly levered and unprofitable companies. HY has continued to underperform IG.
Tighter US financial conditions are associated with rotation into defensives over cyclicals.

Hedge fund gross leverage rose 3.0 pts to 311.7% (79th percentile 1-year) while net leverage fell 3.2 pts to 72.7% (4th percentile). Overall L/S ratio fell to 1.609 (4th percentile). Fundamental L/S net leverage fell 4.2 pts to 48.6%, a 1-year low.

Global equities were net sold (-2.0 SDs 1-year), with long sales outpacing short sales 2.6 to 1. All major regions were net sold, led in dollar terms by EM Asia and North America. Managers cut directional exposure sharply but have not meaningfully reduced long books, so further de-grossing is possible if performance pressure continues.
The 'AI winners' vs 'AI at risk' pair (GSPUARTI) is flat on the year after being up almost 100% from 1 Jan through June month-end.
AI credit spreads (GSUCHS30) and hyperscaler spreads (GSXUHYPR) are at the widest of the year. The last time spreads were this wide, hyperscaler equities were 15% lower.

TMT Spec Sales says the current episode differs from July's technical momentum unwind. Investors disagree on the main overhang (earnings, elections, rates/credit, ROIC, inflation, product momentum, GW build-out execution, policy). Technicals point to possible counter-rallies in the coming days, but investors lack conviction on a clearing event, which suppresses near-term re-grossing.
NDX forward P/E is 20.5x, the lowest since the AI cycle began in 2023, and a ~1.8x premium to the S&P 500, the narrowest in nearly 10 years. Semis de-rated from ~29x this summer to 17x forward P/E.
In the GS prime book, Info Tech was the most net sold global sector last week, with the largest % de-grossing in 2 months and the largest % net selling on record (since 2016).

Hedge funds net sold Global AI stocks (GSXGGLAI) for five straight sessions (Oct 8-14), reversing all cumulative net buying since the start of 2025. Net allocation is 26.1% of global single-stock net MV (peak 31.7% in early June, 49th percentile 1-year). The long/short ratio is 3.27 (peak 4.34, 7th percentile).

Levered ETFs took in nearly $10B last week, the largest weekly inflow in the dataset. SOXL gathered a record +$7B (74% of inflows) and TQQQ added +$1.3B. Levered ETFs hold $152B AUM and $386B gross exposure, the second-lowest since July.

Ben Snider expects S&P 500 EPS growth of 29% in 2026 and 18% in 2027 (adjusted for accounting distortions). Extremely narrow breadth argues for caution on Momentum exposure. GS recommends consumer-facing laggards for catch-up and a screen of defensive quality stocks.
GS raised its global servers TAM by 31% in 2027 and 45% in 2028E, across general and AI servers.
On memory, GS sees a narrowing but still significant technology gap between CXMT and Samsung Electronics / SK Hynix in advanced node DRAM and HBM, despite CXMT's 4F2 announcement.
Japan tech: Buy on Murata, TDK, Taiyo Yuden, Renesas, Rohm and Ibiden. Nichicon upgraded to Buy from Neutral.
Japan semiconductor equipment: Buy on Lasertec, Disco, Tokyo Electron and Ebara.
Japan games and internet: Buy on Capcom, Sony Group and Recruit Holdings. Konami Group (Buy) has long-term eFootball upside. Nintendo earnings forecasts were lowered but the Buy rating is maintained.

tension_points.bull_case: Bottom-up AI ecosystem signals are universally positive, and technicals point to possible counter-rallies. GS also raised its servers TAM by 31% in 2027 and 45% in 2028E.
tension_points.bear_case: Multiple compression across semis (29x to 17x forward P/E), the widest AI and hyperscaler credit spreads of the year, and hedge fund AI net buying since 2025 fully reversed.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Spreads this wide previously coincided with hyperscaler equities 15% lower, so continued widening would confirm the bear case.
